notes.title: Latex, Leather and Ropes: Explore your deepest Fetish Fantasies!
notes.content:
Hey party rockers, we have exciting news to share with you today!

We've been working on something new that we're sure will tickle your fancy.
[h1]Fetish Club[/h1]
The first rule of Fetish Club is: you do not talk about Fetish Club.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/ed07d3515ae893da027f7977d7003fd7702cde1e.jpg[/img]
We've added more than 15 poses specifically designed for this game involving dynamic ropes and new props.
Here's a sneak peek of one of the scenes from the new game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/1d27bb9f2aea253b7b00a6e8df0710e44a340f71.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/d17e832e91454bba949285a24c1468a76d4d8e68.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/7461bf44c1ef1b1161d792a7278fef8ac4ca2ae8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40735653/70d53efa6635726247b6beba9b91fc6800048473.gif[/img]

But that's not all, we'll keep you updated during the next weeks with more exciting news, for now, you can already whishlist Fetish Club [h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906170/Fetish_Club/]HERE[/url][/h3]

notes.title: New animation released and model improvements
notes.content:
Today we are releasing a new version of the game with some new custom animation.
Additionally, we have improved many aspects of the game in the following areas:
[list]
[*]Animation System
[*]Moneyshot
[*]Camera system
[*]Boob jiggle
[/list]

In the next few months we are gearing up to release new and exciting content and more custom poses.
Enjoy.
